AI data centers burn insane amounts of energy and generate massive heat — but startup Atoco is flipping the script. Iss technology ki baat karein to yeh waste heat ko use karke literally air se paani nikaalti hai. No rivers, no pipes, no groundwater. Just heat + smart chemistry = clean drinking water. Yaar, ek baar padhne ke baad you literally cannot stop noticing your own biases. It explains why we're overconfident, why we misjudge risks, and why smart people make dumb choices. 8 million tonnes of plastic enter our oceans every single year — and we've been largely blind to where most of it floats. That just changed. The Ocean Cleanup launched ADIS, an AI-powered camera system that maps large plastic debris drifting at sea, feeding the largest ocean plastic database ever created. Pair that with their solar river interceptors catching trash before it even reaches the ocean

Need to explain an idea fast — whiteboard pe draw karo, link bhejo, done. Excalidraw runs entirely in your browser, no signup, no paywall. Real-time collaboration with anyone, anywhere.

Developers, designers, teachers — sab ke liye solid tool hai yeh. Bookmark it before you need it: excalidraw.com

What do you use for quick diagrams or brainstorming? Drop it below 👇

#BrownBooks #ToolOfDay #Excal

If you're still downloading Postman just to test one API call — stop. Hoppscotch (hoppscotch.io) does everything in your browser: REST, GraphQL, WebSocket, even SSE. Yaar, bilkul free hai — no login, no install, nothing.

It's open-source, fast, and honestly one of those tools you'll use every single day once you find it. Developers swear by it as a lightweight Postman replacement that just works.

An AI model just beat human doctors at diagnosing patients in the ER — and the gap is only growing. Published in a peer-reviewed study (April 2026), it correctly identified conditions in 67% of cases vs roughly 55% for physicians. This isn't sci-fi anymore — it's happening in hospitals right now.

🇮🇳 Hindi mein: AI ne hospital mein doctors ko peeche chod diya — 67% sahi diagnoses, doctors sirf 55%

US startup Captify has built AR glasses that turn any conversation into real-time floating text — right in the wearer's vision — giving deaf and hard-of-hearing people full access to the spoken world.

🇮🇳 Hindi mein: Yeh AR glasses conversation ko seedha aankhon ke saamne text mein dikhate hain — bahre logon ke liye ek game-changer hai.

Agar tum ek aisa insaan jaante ho jise yeh technology ki zar
